_evidence_notice: Reconstructed supplemental evidence, not the original deployment record. The dApp repository's own deploy script (scripts/dev-stack/deploy.sh) did not capture or write deployment transaction hashes anywhere -- this file's transaction fields were recovered after the fact, from public Horizon/Soroban-RPC history, and independently verified against the deployer account's actual on-chain history. Nothing here was captured live by the original deployment run. See docs/TRANCHE_2_DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_CLOSURE.md for the full method and for every verification command, reproducible read-only.

All twelve contracts were uploaded and deployed one at a time by the admin key; MarketFactory (step 10b) was itself deployed but never invoked to create this market's contracts.

source_to_byte_reproducibility.builder_machine: this verification's own machine, rustc 1.94.1 (e408947bf 2026-03-25), same command as the dApp's own (cargo build --workspace --release --target wasm32v1-none) against an isolated `git archive` of commit 665bb6760372d30307a1a035da24e51776f727e8
source_to_byte_reproducibility.result: 0 of 12 byte-identical to the deployed/manifest hashes
source_to_byte_reproducibility.diagnosis: Consistent with, not contradicting, the dApp evidence doc's own TRANCHE_2_EVIDENCE.md section 2.1 finding (their CI runner also got 0 of 12 against the same source) -- most of these wasm files embed the building machine's own absolute path (via the cargo registry path), and the dApp's own matching build used Rust 1.95.0, not this verification's 1.94.1. A controlled comparison supports the version difference as at least a contributing factor: an isolated rebuild of the SAME machine's toolchain (1.94.1) against the separate TR2 deployment's commit aae6cf8 (see ../deployment-manifest.json) DID reproduce 12 of 12 byte-identical, because that manifest's own build was also made with 1.94.1. On-chain code matching the manifest (above) is independently and separately confirmed; this reproducibility result does not change that.
